_comment: copy this file to ~/.bytes-dns/config.json and set permissions: chmod 600 ~/.bytes-dns/config.json
_comment_cloudflare: to sync the record with Cloudflare as well, add a "cloudflare" block with an API token (Zone:Read + Zone:DNS:Edit), e.g. "cloudflare": {"api_token": "...", "zone": "example.com", "record": "home.example.com"} - see the README section "Cloudflare"
